Overview of Product


The High-Precision Globe-shaped Gyro Stabilization System is an integrated, highly stable electro-optical observation platform designed for all-weather, all-directional security. Its spherical design enables 360° omnidirectional rotation and wide field-of-view coverage, while advanced gyro-stabilization technology ensures clear, steady imagery even under complex environments and high-speed motion. Built with military-grade reliability, it supports flexible integration of multiple sensors—including visible cameras, thermal imagers, and laser rangefinders—and excels in aerial, maritime, and ground security missions. From border patrol and maritime law enforcement to environmental monitoring and critical infrastructure protection, it provides dependable support for target observation and intelligence acquisition in dynamic scenarios.



Product Features


360° Omnidirectional Stabilization

The spherical architecture delivers balanced multi-axis compensation for roll, pitch, and yaw. It maintains full-range stability in rough seas or on moving platforms, minimizing motion blur and maximizing detection/tracking performance for continuous security.


Military-Grade Reliability

Engineered for demanding missions, it features shock- and vibration-hardened mechanics, sealed housings, and corrosion resistance. It withstands salt-fog, spray, and temperature extremes (-40℃ to +55℃ operating temperature), aligning with protection and marine test standards for long-term deployment.


Precision Target Tracking

High-sensitivity gyroscopes and advanced control algorithms achieve stabilization accuracy of ≤0.2mrad (RMS) and repeat positioning accuracy of ±0.01°. It keeps optics precisely aligned during maneuvers and wave impact, supporting long-range identification and evidence-grade recording.


Multi-Sensor Flexibility

An open, modular platform supports visible cameras (200Mp/400Mp), thermal imagers (640×512@17μm to 1280×1024@12μm), laser rangefinders (5km–20km optional), and mission-specific payloads. Standardized interfaces simplify integration with existing systems.


High-Speed Maneuver Adaptability

With a pan speed of ≥100°/s and tilt speed of ≥80°/s, it rapidly locks onto fast-moving targets. It accelerates at ≥100°/s² (pan) and ≥80°/s² (tilt), ensuring responsiveness in dynamic security scenarios.


Applications


Maritime Security & Border Protection

Installed on patrol vessels and coastal protection platforms, it enables round-the-clock monitoring of waterways and offshore zones. For border protection, it monitors cross-border vessels and suspicious activities, supporting anti-smuggling and anti-infiltration efforts.


Military Operations

Suitable for shipborne, vehicle-mounted, or fixed-base deployment, it supports long-range target identification and battlefield awareness. It enables all-weather tactical security and target tracking to assist reconnaissance and command missions.


Critical Infrastructure Protection

Applied to sea-crossing bridges, offshore platforms, and dams, it provides continuous monitoring and early warning. It detects approaching threats, safeguarding strategic facilities against intrusion or sabotage for uninterrupted operations.


Aerial & Ground Security

Integrated into UAVs, helicopters, or ground vehicles, it conducts aerial reconnaissance and ground target tracking. It is effective for disaster monitoring, environmental research, and urban security, enhancing situational control in diverse terrains.


FAQ


What is the weight and dimension of the globe-shaped system?

It offers two configurations: ≤50Kg (400mm × 600mm × 650mm) and ≤100Kg (920mm × 650mm × 930mm), accommodating different installation requirements for vessels, aircraft, or fixed platforms.


Can the system be customized with specific sensors?

Yes, it supports full customization of sensors, detectors, and gimbal functions. We can design unique configurations based on your requirements for sensor type, environmental conditions, and mission objectives.


What encoding formats does the camera support?

It uses H.265/H.264 encoding, ensuring efficient video compression without quality loss—ideal for real-time transmission and long-term storage of security footage.

Long-Range High-Clarity Short-Wave Thermal Camera
The short wave infrared (SWIR) thermal cameras operate in the 0.9–3 μm spectrum, detecting reflected infrared radiation rather than relying solely on emitted heat. The imaging of short wave Infrared (SWIR) thermal camera closely resembles visible light, offering sharp details and the ability to see through glass.
 
With high resolution and adaptability to bright or complex lighting conditions, short wave infrared (SWIR) thermal cameras excel in industrial inspection, scientific research, night vision enhancement, and detecting camouflaged targets. Built-in high-performance digital processor, using high-efficiency compression algorithm, the video is clear, real-time and smooth. We also provide flexible small-batch customization, tailoring systems to specific mission requirements and operational environments.

20kg-loaded Stable High-Torque U-Shaped Pan-Tilt
The u-shaped pan tilt system is an advanced sighting and tracking system that integrates high-precision optical sensors (HD visible-light cameras, infrared thermal imagers, laser rangefinders, etc.) with a high-speed, high-precision servo-controlled rotational mechanism. Its most distinctive external feature is its u-shaped support structure, it achieves movement in two degrees of freedom, enabling it to rapidly, stably, and precisely point and lock the optical sensors onto any target in space. Leveraging its unique u-shaped configuration, the high-speed u-shaped pan tilt achieves a perfect balance of rigidity, precision, speed, and stability. The u-shaped pan tilt system serves as the core platform for modern high-end observation, tracking, and targeting systems, with wide-ranging applications across critical domains from the battlefield to the city.
